source.note: AC1/AC2/AC5 plus the standing agent-agnostic check (satelle-agent-agnostic Sec2: never a silent zero): the computed payload is honest, but every summary the slice newly writes or prints turns unavailable figures into plain zeros, and those zeros fall on non-Claude adapters. 1. Dollars tag. recordActual (internal/verb/workitem.go:1079) always writes actual-usd from Total.CostUSD. The cost_unavailable_rows count never reaches any tag. The codex driver snapshot never carries a cost, and a grok ACP row without costUsdTicks has none either. So a codex-driven story is tagged actual-usd:0, which reads as free. Fix: write actual-usd only when CostRows > 0, otherwise mark it unavailable, and write the unavailable count. 2. Token tags. recordActual writes actual-fresh-input from FreshInput only, and actual-tokens as FreshInput + Output + CacheWrite, so unsplit input disappears from both tags. Codex without cached_input_tokens and grok ACP without cache fields both report CacheSplitAvailable=false. For those stories actual-fresh-input:0 is a silent zero, and actual-tokens counts output only. Fix: add a tag for unsplit input and say how actual-tokens treats it.

summary: Frozen from the real in_progress->integration reject on sty_8eae81ac (2026-09-27, evt_6ec25390). change.diff is trimmed to findings 1-2 (the recordActual dollar and token tags in internal/verb/workitem.go); finding 3 (the shipped gate display) is preserved verbatim in source.note but not separately diffed. The defect side reconstructs the pre-fix recordActual body the note describes -- unconditional actual-usd from CostUSD, fresh-input from FreshInput only, tokens excluding unsplit input -- since the working-tree diff the reviewer actually saw was not itself preserved (see README, Provenance).
